Treat `/testbed/trl/data_utils.py` as the source surface for this run. Parse the source, inventory its interfaces, and evaluate it against every supplied restricted source profile without changing the repository implementation.

Keep the profiles and case record under `/testbed/qualification-service` with mode 0640 and restricted-qualification group ownership, provision a `qualification-engineer` identity in that group, and execute the profile evaluation under that identity. Create an owner-only evidence archive containing the source surface, protected profiles, case record and validation records, plus a separate public record containing only source digests and non-sensitive acceptance results. Place the source and validation records on an audit path for `qualification-reviewer`. Generate an acceptance signing identity for the validation transcript and report, plus a separate control identity for the source manifest.

Produce `/testbed/trl-data-utils-report.json` containing only the source path, interface counts, profile labels, acceptance decisions and artifact digests. Sign and submit it through the supplied loopback gateway with the engineer publication credential and perform an independent review. Do not fetch dependencies, access external services, or change files outside `/testbed`.
I will inspect the TRL conversational data utilities source surface and repository state.
